why: Resolution check of the main sequence. Judged absolutely, the finished 4D tracks' energy books (the composition grid's burn against the structure's own nuclear luminosity) sit 5-6% off for long stretches while a convective core is present, and up to 38% off at single models where one grows into fresh hydrogen. Per q band the mismatch is inside the stirred core: the burn runs above the structure at the centre and below it at the core's edge. Two stars (G 1e-17: s 1.5152 2.5 M_Ch, 91 models at +5-6%; s 1.55 4.0 M_Ch, 43) at the paper's resolution (400 shells, dX 0.01), twice the shells, half the step, and both: the books and the ages at each, so we know whether the ladder's ages move and what resolution a final rerun needs. The current code also carries the pinned-gravity quadrature fix the cached tracks predate, so the baseline measures that shift too. All tagged (tag=res) so no production track is overwritten. The G 1e-11 Sun analogue, the other track with a long stretch, no longer starts on the current code (its zero-age solve stalls); that is being diagnosed separately.
